WIXON HOMESTEAD'''''
''At the foot of the valley below Vault 76 is a small farmstead, now the home to a clan of Scorched. Check under the porch for a safe, and remember to locate more items in the main farmhouse, the equipment barn, and the larger barn near the two silos. The field nearby is one of the flattest areas in all of Appalachia; try building a camp there if you want."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) ==Layout== The farm includes four main buildings, a two-story house and a barn to the south, as well as a shed and a rounded storage building on top of a hill to the west. The only inhabitant of the homestead aside from the invading [[Scorched]] is [[Cheswick II]], a [[Cat (Fallout 76)|cat]] on the second floor of the house. A [[tinker's workbench]] can be found inside of the shed, while a [[weapons workbench (Fallout 76)|weapons workbench]] is inside of the storage building. An [[Armor workbench (Fallout 76)|armor workbench]] is in the barn near the two silos. A [[Water pump (Fallout 76)|water pump]] can be found here as well. Four [[Carrot (Fallout 76)|carrots]] and two [[Melon blossom (Fallout 76)|melon blossoms]] can be found here at the home's northern garden. ==Notable loot== * [[Message to Sammy]] - Note, on the second floor of the farmhouse. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - In the hangar area, near the large storage shelf, on a barrel. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - On the second floor of the farmhouse, by the east wall of the bedroom, on the small ornate table. * Three potential [[Fallout 76 plans#Armor|armor plans/mods]]: ** In the hangar, on a metal shelf next to a [[Weapons workbench (Fallout 76)|weapons workbench]]. ** Inside the barn, on a metal shelf at the northeastern corner (armor plan). ** Inside the barn, on a metal barrel to the right of an armor workbench (armor mod). * Potential [[Fallout 76 weapon mods|weapon mod]] - In the hangar, on a metal shelf next to a weapons workbench. ==Appearances== The Wixon homestead appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== Wixon homestead first floor.png|First floor Wixon homestead second floor.png|Second floor Wixon homestead bathroom.png|Bathroom F76 Wixon Homestead 2.png F76 Wixon Homestead 1.png Wixon homestead exterior.png Wixon homestead exterior 2.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[de:Gutshof Wixon]] [[fr:Domaine de Wixon]] [[ru:Ферма Виксонов]] [[uk:Ферма Віксонів]] [[zh:威克森農莊]]

'''Alexis (Alex)''' is a [[Miss Nanny (Fallout 76)|Miss Nanny]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]].            

==Background==
This chipper Miss Nanny is one of the robotic vendors the Whitespring replaced their human staff with shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> She resides in the Newsstand store of the Whitespring's mall area and sells a variety of junk and burned reading materials.

'''Scout Leader Pompy''' is a [[Mister Handy (Fallout 76)|Mister Handy]] operating at the [[Kiddie Corner Cabins]] in [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
Pompy is one of the Pioneer Scout leaders still operational in Appalachia. He is responsible for teaching new scouts on how to clean up [[Toxic mutagenic waste|waste]] and dispose of it safely.

This is part of the requirements to complete The Order of the Tadpole and be promoted to Possum in the Pioneer Scouts.
